title: Vegan Tostada Fiesta
description: A flavorful and vibrant vegan tostada recipe, perfect for a delicious and colorful meal. This dish combines the crunch of tostadas with the freshness of Mexican-inspired flavors.
instructions: Brush both sides of the tostadas with olive oil and place on a baking sheet.
Bake the tostadas for 5-7 minutes or until crispy and lightly browned.
In a medium bowl, mix together the black beans, diced tomatoes, diced avocado, diced red onion, and chopped cilantro.
Squeeze the lime juice over the top of the mixture and season with salt and pepper to taste.
To assemble the tostadas, place a spoonful of the black bean mixture onto each tostada.
Optional: Top with sliced radishes, diced jalapeños, or a sprinkle of nutritional yeast for extra flavor and crunch.
